Good to know

Questions, answered.

What does title insurance protect?

Title insurance protects your ownership investment by ensuring the seller is the true owner and that no outstanding issues transfer to you. A policy is paid once, has no renewal premiums or expiration date, and protects you and your heirs as long as you maintain an interest in the property.

Do you serve only Colorado?

No. We operate across Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Kansas, Missouri, Nebraska, and Tennessee.

What's included in your settlement fee?

Our low bundled settlement fee of $200 includes closing services anywhere in the Denver Metro Area.

Can you handle FSBO transactions?

Yes. We offer title and closing services for for-sale-by-owner transactions with no additional FSBO fees.

Do you offer mobile closing?

Yes. We provide mobile closing services and notary services, including evenings and weekends.

How long have you been in business?

We've been providing title and settlement services for over 13 years, growing from an in-house agency into an independent, full-service operation.
